meta.topic: State/city/county/housing-authority programs that pay or guarantee rent to private landlords (HCV payment standards, landlord incentives, risk-mitigation funds, source-of-income law, open datasets)
meta.method: Official PHA/city/state pages and PDFs fetched with Python requests (pymupdf/pypdf text extraction; image tables read visually); WordPress search/media APIs on PHA sites; Metro HRA payment-standard API; Socrata API test for Austin; web search for legal status. No Firecrawl. No tenant-level data collected.
meta.verified_legend: true = read on official source this session; partial = official source found but a key number/date missing or stale; false = from secondary source / memory, must verify
meta.note_payment_standards: Payment standard = max gross rent (rent + tenant utility allowance) the PHA subsidizes. SAFMR = HUD Small Area FMR, set per ZIP. Summary stats (min/median/max) computed by us from the PDF tables.

payment_standards.notes: MPHA set standards BELOW HUD FMR (2027 FMR 2BR $1,734) because of federal funding shortfall; 3BR+ frozen.

programs.program: MPHA Landlord Excellence Program (LEP) - damage claims
programs.landlord_gets: Tiered by inspection pass rate/abatements: Gold tier damage claims up to $2,500 beyond security deposit + biennial inspections + photo proof of repairs; Standard tier up to $1,250; Remediation tier no claims and $50 reinspection fee from 2nd reinspection.
programs.unit_eligibility: Active MPHA tenant-based HCV units; project-based units excluded; tiers assigned July 1 each year from prior Jul-Jun record.

programs.program: MPHA HCV landlord onboarding / inspections / listing
programs.landlord_gets: Guaranteed HAP; owner portal; inspections before move-in then annual or biennial (NSPIRE-style HQS).
programs.unit_eligibility: Pass MPHA inspection; rent reasonable; list free on HousingLink.

programs.program: Property Owner Risk Mitigation Fund (RMF) Program
programs.administrator: Minnesota Housing (grants to local administrators incl. Tribal Nations, counties, nonprofits that meet FHPAP criteria)
programs.landlord_gets: Reimbursement for damages or other eligible financial losses exceeding the security deposit, through local grantee; also owner services/liaison.
programs.unit_eligibility: Owner enrolled with an RMF grantee; renter household FHPAP-eligible. Grant period Apr 2026 - Mar 2030 (RFP closed Dec 2025). Per-claim caps set by each grantee - not verified.

programs.program: Saint Paul PHA HCV owners - rent setting & inspections
programs.landlord_gets: HAP; Partner Portal; rent reasonableness vs 3 market comparables in same ZIP/bedrooms/type.
programs.unit_eligibility: Inspection required; no landlord bonus program found on site.

programs.landlord_gets: Arrears paid on behalf of tenants at risk of eviction (amounts not verified).

programs.program: Housing Support (formerly Group Residential Housing) and Housing Stabilization Services (Medicaid)
programs.landlord_gets: Housing Support: state pays monthly room-and-board rate to provider/landlord for eligible adults (rate not verified). Housing Stabilization Services (Medicaid) was reported terminated in 2025 after fraud investigations - NOT verified this session.
programs.unit_eligibility: Provider agreement with county; some settings licensed.

programs.program: Children First North Texas (high-opportunity mobility) + Housing Connector enhanced incentives
programs.administrator: Dallas Housing Authority with Housing Connector (nonprofit)
programs.landlord_gets: Signing bonus up to $1,250; supplemental rent if tenant hardship; via Housing Connector: emergency rent up to 3 months over a 2-year lease max, damage mitigation up to $5,000 beyond deposit, vacancy loss up to 1 month if tenant abandons/early move-out, eviction mediation.
programs.unit_eligibility: Unit in qualifying high-opportunity area; families with children <18. Check address in DHA Rental Property Incentives Finder.
programs.how_to_list: DHA landlord portal / schedule appointment at dhantx.com/landlords

programs.landlord_gets: Higher payment standard: 125% of SAFMR by ZIP (2026 median 2BR $2,300).

programs.program: Austin Housing Authority HCV landlord business center
programs.landlord_gets: HAP; inspections; rent reviews on request. No current signing-bonus/damage fund found on HACA site.
HAP (first check 30-60 days after HAP contract); rent reasonableness via Socialserve. No landlord bonus/damage fund on DHA site - damages are between owner and tenant.

programs.program: Temporary Rent and Utility Assistance (TRUA) - ERA successor
programs.administrator: City of Denver Dept. of Housing Stability (HOST)
programs.landlord_gets: Rent paid on behalf of tenants; 2026 budget proposed $15.1M (from $12.2M) per CBS report.

programs.program: Division of Housing voucher programs - security deposit and damage payment process
programs.administrator: Colorado Dept. of Local Affairs, Division of Housing (DOH)
programs.landlord_gets: Security deposit and damage payments for units leased under DOH supportive-housing vouchers (CoC PSH, State Housing Vouchers etc.); amounts not verified.
programs.unit_eligibility: Unit leased to DOH voucher participant.

programs.administrator: Boulder County Housing & Human Services, funded with Boulder County Housing Authority, Boulder Housing Partners, City of Boulder
programs.landlord_gets: $500-$2,500 per claim for tenant-caused damage after deposit and insurance; first 3 years of tenancy; leases effective 2023-03-01 or later. Excludes lost rent, arrears, mold, infestations, common areas, legal fees.
programs.unit_eligibility: Unit in Boulder County leased with any federal/state/local voucher or rental assistance.

programs.landlord_gets: One-time incentive to new owners (or returning after >2 years); AMOUNT NOT STATED in flyer.
programs.unit_eligibility: Excludes BHP/PHA-owned units and any unit with recorded affordability covenant (e.g., LIHTC).

programs.landlord_gets: HAP after contract; inspection within 1-10 days of RTA; quarterly landlord class. No bonus/damage fund found. Payment standards reduced to 100% SAFMR for new contracts from 2026-08-01 due to HUD funding shortfall.
Guaranteed HAP; HQS/NSPIRE inspections; 'List your unit' page. No bonus program found.
$1,000 per unit for first 5 new units, max $5,000 per new landlord, paid after first HAP; first come first served while funds last.
programs.unit_eligibility: Landlord with no THA HCV subsidy in prior 12 months. Flyer dated 2020 (web banner 2023) - CURRENT AVAILABILITY UNVERIFIED.

programs.landlord_gets: HAP paid monthly; initial payment within 45 days; biennial inspections (HQS + City of Tulsa code); 3-part landlord certification training.
HAP by direct deposit; annual inspections at no cost; own lease; refers searchers to AffordableHousing.com. Units must also hold KCMO Healthy Homes rental permit.

programs.program: KCMO landlord mitigation fund (tied to 2024 source-of-income ordinance)
programs.administrator: City of Kansas City, MO (Civil Rights & Equal Opportunity)
programs.landlord_gets: $1M fund to offset costs of accepting vouchers (per KCUR); current status after 2025 state preemption UNKNOWN.
HAP; landlord portal; no bonus program found.

programs.administrator: Housing Authority of the Birmingham District
programs.landlord_gets: HAP; landlord property registration packet; HQS move-in checklist; no bonus program found.

source_of_income_law.status: MN Human Rights Act protects 'status with regard to public assistance'; whether that covers Section 8 refusal is contested (2010 Ct. App. decision allowed refusal). Bills HF 2021/SF 2097 (2025-26) to explicitly ban voucher discrimination introduced, not enacted as of last action 2026-04-30.
YES - city Civil Rights ordinance bars refusing renters using Section 8 / rent subsidies and 'no Section 8' ads; upheld after injunction dissolved.
Unknown at city level - check Saint Paul Human Rights ordinance (Ch. 183).
NO - Tex. Local Gov't Code 250.007 (SB 267, 2015) bars cities/counties from forbidding refusal of voucher holders; voluntary incentive programs allowed. Applies to Dallas and Austin.
YES - statewide source-of-income protection incl. housing vouchers (HB20-1332, C.R.S. 24-34-501/502). Applies Denver & Boulder.
No statewide protection; HB 150 (135th GA) proposed. ~19 cities have local SOI laws.
YES - Ordinance 0494-2021 (Housing for All), effective 2021-07-01, enforced from 2021-09-01; covers vouchers.
YES (reported) - city SOI ordinance (2020); listed among Ohio cities with SOI law.
No state or Tulsa SOI protection found.
NO (preempted) - KC ordinance (eff. Aug 2024) banning voucher discrimination made unenforceable by state HB 595 signed by Gov. Kehoe July 2025 (eff. Aug 28, 2025).
No state or city SOI protection found.
